structure: Part 16 read every file under features/cph-number/ and features/permanent-address/ in repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend, except the *.test.js unit tests (copy/copy.test.js was opened but not claimed): for cph-number, page.js, controller.js, template.njk, validate.js, shape.js, evaluation.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js and cph-number.fit.spec.js; for permanent-address, page.js, controller.js, template.njk, cards.js, answers.js, write.js, validate.js, summary.js, saved-addresses.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js and permanent-address.fit.spec.js. addresses/party-edit/address-rules.js and its copy were read only to confirm the length caps, email rule and over-long messages the permanent address page borrows. It covers two sub-pages of the consignment-parties section, both reached from add links on the consignment addresses page: the county parish holding (CPH) number page at /cph-number (one fieldset of three numeric boxes, a collapsed help details, per-part validation, the whole-number-in-the-county-box split, the stored-number check, the out-of-scope skip and its obligation binding), and the permanent address page at /permanent-address (one summary card per identified animal on a line the permanentAddress gate applies to, two radio options with a revealed eight-box UK address, validation and its animal-named summary, how answers are written onto each animal's record, the saved-address list other pages read, the task-complete rule, the skip, and the two no-animal messages that replace the cards). Both fit specs are claimed test by test, and both Welsh copy files for key parity and their machine-draft marker. The consignment contact page and contact-address section are gone from the journey, so the earlier extract's contact claims are not carried.
